notes.title: 🎉 Big Update in Cloud Cats’ Land 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3][i][b]🎉 Big Update in Cloud Cats’ Land 🎉[/b][/i][/h3][p][/p][h3]We’ve been carefully reading your feedback and noticed something interesting: for some players the game felt a bit too easy, while for others it seemed almost impossible to beat 🐾[/h3][h3]As a result, many didn’t get the experience they were hoping for.[/h3][p][/p][p]To fix this imbalance, we’ve improved the hint system:[/p][p]✨ On Normal difficulty, holding the "Shift" key will now show only interaction points.[/p][p]✨ On Easy difficulty, a separate button will highlight all available interactions on the screen — and even in the inventory.[/p][p]✨ And for those who want a truly relaxing journey, we’ve added a Very Easy mode – with it, absolutely anyone can complete the game 😉[/p][p][/p][p]But! 👀 To keep the adventure fun, some collectibles remain without hints — you’ll need your attention and imagination to find them.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also:[/p][p]🐞 Fixed various bugs[/p][p]⚙️ Added screen mode options in the graphics settings

[/p][p]If you notice any bugs or localization errors, please email us at: [url="https://cloudcatsgame@gmail.com"]cloudcatsgame@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and feedback 💙[/p][p][/p][p]Happy adventures in the world of Cloud Cats! ☁️🐱[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello, my little kitties! 🐱💕

I just uploaded an updated demo of my game to Steam — now with even more cuteness, mystery, and adventure! 🐾


What’s new?

-   THREE chapters are now available instead of two — more story, more puzzles!

-   Added the lighthouse keeper’s journal — who is he? What secrets does the island hold? The intrigue!

-   Collectible items for the kitties — because they deserve all the treasures in the world!

-   Started adding mini-games where they belong — fun times ahead!

-   Fixed how the fish interacts with objects — no more chopping down the mightiest tree in the forest... with a herring. 😅 (Yes, that really happened. I’m so sorry!)

 -  Changed click response — now you can close text windows not just with right-click.

-   Fixed sooo many bugs I lost count!

The mysterious island and the Cloud Cats are waiting for you! 💖

With love,
Katya
(^｡• ᵕ •｡^)

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216820/5ce93805b0edb9d9d227451de2a4285e2ad4d115.jpg[/img]

Dear players, we are pleased to announce the update of the demo version of our game. The new version includes the following improvements and innovations:

- Added a new chapter: Tutorial, which will help new players to get acquainted with the game world faster. And at the same time it gives the premise of how we ended up on the island.
- Added achievements.
- The tree hollow  mini-game has been simplified and reduced by 30%, making it more accessible to players.
- Various bugs and inaccuracies that interfered with the comfortable passage of the demo version have been fixed.

We hope that these changes will make the gameplay even more exciting and smooth. Join us and discover the updated demo version!
